args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high: unbounded recursion
when parsing deeply nested arrays). 2.9.4 is the fixed version in the
2.x line.

args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 → 2.9.4 (fixes CVE-2026-31337)
args.body:
## Summary
- Bumps the `fastjson` pin in `requirements.txt` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4.
- 2.8.0 is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays).
- 2.9.4 is the fixed release in the 2.x line (fixed_in: 2.9.4, 3.1.0).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878`: ✅ passed
